_note: Registration snippet — AUTHORING-BRIEF 'Registration protocol'. Content
agents do not touch content/manifest.js, content/manifest.json or
server/lib/rules.php; the integrator applies this and deletes the file.
APPLY AFTER al4: al5 is the FIFTH region of the aeneis track and must
follow al1..al4 in the manifest's regions array — js/app.js regionIndex()
reads that order and feeds it to the phase engine as the ONE difficulty
input (DESIGN §6).
al5 is a PROBĀTIŌ liber (kind: 'probatio', boss id b_al5) with TWO phases:
ordina (hp 6 / 45 s) + sententia (hp 5 / 55 s) — the al2 shape, because
this is the track's other ordina liber and the two should tune alike.
Legacy single-phase tuning in the content file is hp 11 / 100 s.
bossMinMs 15000 matches l2/l3/al1/al2/al3/al4.
The ordina phase declares its categories in the content file and does NOT
declare `items`: js/probatio.js then draws from the liber's whole
vocabulary and drops every word no category claims (zoneOf), so exactly
eight words can fall (rēmus, saxum, cursus, gubernātor / praemium, pellis,
corōna, equus). Nothing for rules.php to know — recorded so the integrator
does not go looking for an item list.
quizKey carries the same three keys per row as al1-al4: rules.php stores
{q, a}, and `correct` is always 0 against the boss.quiz order in
content/aeneis-al5.js. Region id 'al5', not 'l5' — rules.php keys regions
in one flat namespace and 'l5' is Historia's (see a-l1.reg.json).
al5 is a NEW region: its content id IS its progressId, so it needs no
entry in rule_region_aliases().
XP mirrors al1-al4 exactly.
